name: aurion-aios-builder
description: Train immediately callable AIOS employees in one durable session, then invoke them through Aurion AIOS.

interface.shortDescription: Train and immediately use AI employees
interface.longDescription: Create or revise an AI employee conversationally in ChatGPT, Codex, Claude or Cursor, keep one durable training session per employee, make every complete snapshot immediately callable, and invoke the employee through the same account-scoped Remote MCP.
capabilities: One durable training session per employee
defaultPrompt: Help me build an AI employee for a recurring business task.
Continue one of my unfinished AI employee builds.
Review and improve the latest draft of my AI employee.
Add a new Skill to one of my existing AIOS employees.
Use one of my active AIOS employees to complete this task.
Archive one of my AIOS employees after confirming its exact name.
